```dart
String fileNameCheck(String fileName) {
  final List<int> chars = fileName.codeUnits;
  
  // Check if the first character is a backslash
  if (chars.isNotEmpty && chars[0] == '\\' && fileName.length > 1) {
    int length = fileName.length;
    
    // Create new list with one less element
    List<int> newChars = List<int>.filled(length - 1, 0);
    
    // Copy characters from original excluding the first one
    for (int i = 1; i < length; i++) {
      newChars[i-1] = chars[i];
    }
    
    return String.fromCharCodes(newChars);
  } else {
    return fileName;
  }
}
```
